verdict.rationale: Postman docs confirm a spec-first design capability via Spec Hub, letting developers design an API's structure before building requests (postman-docs-16), and governance checks against API specifications (postman-docs-22) imply spec management. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents OpenAPI import/export functionality from Spec Hub or collections. missing for 10: explicit documentation of OpenAPI export/import from Spec Hub, hands-on confirmation of exporting a spec as an OpenAPI file.
